system.description:
Spears, lances or pikes are versatile and intuitive weapons. They can be used as a quick slashing weapon, as a thrusting or even a smashing weapon. This is not a throwing skill.

Obstacles: See the Fight chapter of the Burning Wheel.

FoRKs: Martial Arts, Boxing or any appropriate melee weapon skill.

Skill Type: Martial. Tools: No.

Root: Agility

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 300
